bsky_posts.text:
CW: pet death 

The last of my elderly pet rats passed while we were at BFC. Geno was nearly 3 years old.

I am no longer a rat parent.

I have loved them all so much. They were such beautiful, friendly little souls. I am going to miss them for the rest of my life. 💔
